block.vector_store.model.title: Vector Store
block.vector_store.model.description: Embed texts and search them by meaning in a local vector collection.
block.vector_store.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.vector_store.help_collection: Collection name in this node's storage (letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen). Each collection keeps one embedding model.
block.vector_store.help_base_url: OpenAI-compatible API root; the block calls <base_url>/embeddings. Loopback servers (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM) work as is; other hosts need allow_remote.
block.vector_store.help_model: Embedding model name sent to the endpoint. A collection refuses vectors from another model.
block.vector_store.help_api_key_ref: Optional wallet reference for a Bearer API key, e.g. secret://workspace/embeddings_key. Never paste the key itself.
block.vector_store.help_top_k: Number of matches returned by a query (1–100). A query message may override it.
block.vector_store.help_min_score: Minimum cosine similarity, from -1 to 1. Lower-scoring items are not returned.
block.vector_store.help_chunk_size: Split texts into chunks of about this many characters, cut at whitespace. 0 keeps each text whole.
block.vector_store.help_chunk_overlap: Characters repeated between consecutive chunks, at most half of chunk_size.
block.vector_store.help_allow_delete: Allow delete messages (by ids, metadata filter or all). Off by default.
block.vector_store.help_query_prefix: Text prepended to each query before embedding, for models that expect one (e.g. search_query: ).
block.vector_store.help_document_prefix: Text prepended to each chunk before embedding (e.g. search_document: ). Not stored in the returned text.
block.vector_store.help_allow_remote: Allow a non-loopback embeddings host (LAN or Internet). Off by default; link-local and metadata addresses stay blocked.
block.vector_store.help_allow_insecure_h: Allow plain HTTP to a non-loopback host. An API key is never sent this way.
block.vector_store.help_ca_file: Optional absolute path of a PEM CA file for an HTTPS endpoint with a private certificate authority.
block.vector_store.help_timeout_sec: Total time allowed for one message, embeddings requests included.
block.vector_store.help_max_items: Maximum stored items (chunks) in the collection. A message that would exceed it is rolled back.
block.vector_store.help_max_text_chars: Maximum characters sent to the model for one chunk or query.
block.vector_store.help_max_input_bytes: Maximum size of one input message in bytes.
block.vector_store.help_max_response_byt: Maximum size of one embeddings response in bytes.
block.vector_store.help_max_database_mb: Maximum size of the collection file in MiB.
block.vector_store.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
